title: 90-Minute Private Airboat Tour in Kissimmee
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Ages 2 and under must weigh at least 18 lbs. to ride the boat.
The total weight of the group should be not greater than 1200 lbs.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join an exhilarating 90-minute private airboat tour through the heart of Central Florida's breathtaking wetlands in Kissimmee, where travelers glide across shimmering marshlands on an exclusive excursion. Led by an expert captain navigating deep into the pristine ecosystem, this vibrant outdoor adventure offers an up-close look at native alligators, majestic wading birds, and turtles basking in the sun, delivering an unforgettable and dynamic escape into the wild just minutes away from Orlando.
